remarks: 68 Days Park is a 21-unit multi-family property in the Allentown Historic Preservation District, walking distance to the Buffalo Niagara Medical Campus known as the "Days Park Commons". It sits on more than a half-acre lot and includes parking for 36 vehicles. 14 of the units are 2 bedrooms. 12 of those two-bedroom units have 1 bath. 2 of those 2-bedroom units has 1.5 baths and one of them is a 2 story, town house style unit. The other 7 units are all 1 bedroom, with 1 full bath including a 1-bedroom penthouse unit with a 3,000 square foot roof top patio. 10 of the units have in-unit laundry. The 36-car parking lot is newly surfaced, gated and includes a regulatory closure letter from the D.E.C. following the completion of a phase 1 and phase 2. The parking lot, which can be accessed on Wadsworth Street at the foot of Allen, has a separate address, 20 Wadsworth Buffalo NY 14201, Tax ID:  140200-100-770-0002-014-100. 20 Wadsworth has 11,238 Square Feet of surface area with potential for an additional building 3-4 stories high. Days Park is a picturesque pocket Park designed by Olmsted featuring a long plat of turf, mature shade trees, and restored central fountain. Donated in 1854 by early settler Thomas Day, it serves as a peaceful urban oasis surrounded by 19th century Victorian homes. Days Park sits just West of Allen Street at Wadsworth and Cottage Streets. This property can also be sold together with an additional 20 units also located in Days Park at 118, 120, and 126 Cottage Street, MLS #B1698031
